description: Fork of exp180 (qk=v=96, d_v=24, projected ~1.69 from partial run). Single change: out_proj LUT goes from dense (nap=6, tph=3056, n_outputs=E=64) to sparse_scatter (nap=8, tph=4096, n_outputs=8 -> scatter to E=64). Per-layer: 12.52M -> 8.39M (saves ~4M/layer, ~25M total). Total ~232M (-9.7% vs exp180). Pair coverage 178% -> 318%, votes/output 3056 -> 512. Hard mode (TinyMultiHeadLut, no smooth_mode). V2D/D2V wrap kept on out_proj output. Launch with SPIKY_BIT_ATTN_USE_FORWARD_KERNEL=tc SPIKY_BIT_ATTN_USE_BACKWARD_KERNEL=bf16.
